newsitem.title: UK: Mexico lifts August crude to Europe by 20 cts.
newsitem.headline: Mexico lifts August crude to Europe by 20 cts.

text.p: Mexico has increased its price formulas for Maya and Isthmus crudes to Europe by 20 cents a barrel in August, a trading source said.

State oil company Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) has set the price of Maya crude for Europe at a discount of $2.30 a barrel to the Pemex price formula, while Isthmus has been set at a discount of 66 cents to the formula.

Pemex term crude contract prices are based on formulas comprised of weighted price ratios of crudes and products in the region with a differentials which is generally updated monthly to reflect market conditions.
